description: Budget lifecycle of one campaign, as the bus reveals it. Not the internal state of any consumer.

drafting.description: The campaign exists but has no money against it; no promo it funds is offered.

BUDGET_APPROVED.description: The auditable fields on the campaign are filled in here or nowhere.

funded.description: Money is committed; the window has not opened yet.

serving.description: Promos are being offered and redemptions are being charged against the budget.

REDEMPTION_RECORDED.description: Self-transition — the ordinary case, keyed by campaign-id so the sum needs no sort.

REDEMPTION_REVERSED.description: A reversal lowers the total but never removes the original fact.

exhausted.description: The money ran out. Late redemptions still arrive and are still recorded.

REDEMPTION_RECORDED.description: In-flight quotes convert after the threshold; the overspend is recorded, not refused.

ended.description: The clock ran out or the campaign was cancelled. Unspent budget is released.
